name: steno
description: Steno thinking: compresses the model's internal reasoning into a measured code/math shorthand. Same reasoning, fewer thinking tokens, reply unchanged.

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/src/hooks/steno-activate.js"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/src/hooks/steno-activate.js" --subagent
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; HOOK_ROOT=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | sed 's|^/\([a-zA-Z]\)/|\1:/|'); node "$HOOK_ROOT/src/hooks/steno-mode-tracker.js"
